name: Dylan's Open Mats
subtitle: Weekend jiu-jitsu open mats, Jupiter to Miami
description: Every weekend jiu-jitsu open mat from Jupiter down to Miami and out west, on a cork board: a map with a numbered pin for each gym, and a Saturday paper and a Sunday paper listing every open mat by time.

Gi open mats are in blue, no-gi in red, both in purple, and the free ones get a green FREE stamp. On the day, what's over is crossed off and what's on now turns red. Tap any gym for its address, its times, directions and its Instagram.
features: Saturday and Sunday open mats, by time
A map with a numbered pin for every gym
Gi in blue, no-gi in red, both in purple
On the day: what's over is crossed off, what's on now is in red
Tap a gym for directions and its Instagram
